purpose: Repair the primitive D4 charge topology without changing the physical ensemble by retaining each periodic triangular branch and its provenance before any sequential-policy risk is recomputed.
epistemic_role: Topology and model-remediation audit only. It produces no sequential risk, LER, threshold, scalable-decoder, or fault-tolerance claim.

scientific_question.primary: Can every same-colour triangular edge of periodic_honeycomb(2) be represented as a distinct physical branch, and can every post-flux parity relation be mapped to that branch from the actual two-step union path rather than guessed from endpoints?
scientific_question.mechanism: Parallel triangular branches share endpoint incidence but pass through different opposite-colour centres and carry different primitive displacements, so endpoint-only relations preserve charge boundary while erasing torus winding.

competing_hypotheses.h1: A branch-labelled multigraph with stable edge id, endpoints, opposite-colour centre, and primitive displacement resolves the ambiguity and yields exactly four charge homology classes per colour.
competing_hypotheses.h2: Endpoint-only post-flux data are insufficient, but deriving provenance from the actual two-step union paths uniquely identifies every physical branch.
competing_hypotheses.h3: The current union invariant loses enough local path information that some relations still have zero or multiple compatible branches; primitive sequential risk must then remain censored pending a new exact model or method.

registered_representation.relation_provenance: Infer a relation branch from the actual pair of red-union edges incident on its opposite-colour centre; endpoints alone are a lossy projection and may not choose a branch.
registered_representation.forgetful_projection: After discarding branch labels, the enriched relation object must reproduce the existing endpoint connectivity and parity partition exactly.
registered_representation.homology: Compute winding from branch displacements modulo the period matrix and validate it against lifted paths in the universal cover.

smallest_discriminating_matrix.name: branch_catalog
smallest_discriminating_matrix.scope: both blue and green charge colours
smallest_discriminating_matrix.test: Enumerate twelve stable physical edge ids per colour; allow duplicate incidence columns, but require unique centre/displacement-labelled branches.

smallest_discriminating_matrix.name: relation_provenance
smallest_discriminating_matrix.test: Infer branch-labelled relations from actual two-step union paths, compare the endpoint-forgotten DSU partition with the current relation object, and count zero, one, or multiple compatible branches without guessing.

smallest_discriminating_matrix.name: parallel_boundary_winding_fixtures
smallest_discriminating_matrix.scope: every parallel endpoint pair in both colours
smallest_discriminating_matrix.test: Verify equal charge boundary, distinct branch displacement, branch-pair closure, and the expected relative torus winding.

smallest_discriminating_matrix.name: charge_action_quotient
smallest_discriminating_matrix.scope: every supported syndrome after provenance passes
smallest_discriminating_matrix.test: Exhaustively quotient affine charge chains and require exactly four homology classes per colour with loss constant within each class.

smallest_discriminating_matrix.name: public_decoder_branch_fidelity
smallest_discriminating_matrix.test: Determine whether PyMatching preserves distinct branch fault ids and weights; if not, fail the public-decoder gate and register an expanded-graph adapter separately.

required: all source hashes match the registration freeze
each colour has exactly twelve unique stable branch ids and six endpoint pairs of multiplicity two
parallel branches have equal binary boundary and distinct centre/displacement labels
each enriched relation records the actual opposite-colour centre and a physical branch id
forgetting branch labels recovers the current endpoint-only DSU connectivity and parity partition exactly
no enriched relation has zero or multiple physical-branch provenance
branch homology is invariant under representative and lifted-path choices
every parallel-pair XOR is closed and realizes its expected relative winding
the exhaustive even-syndrome action quotient has exactly four classes per colour and loss is constant within class
public second-stage branch fidelity is explicitly tested rather than inferred from endpoint syndrome
no larger lattice, approximate posterior, new stochastic sample, policy risk, LER, or threshold claim is introduced
validation.fail_closed_rule: Stop before the homology quotient if any relation has zero or multiple branch provenance. Stop before public-policy reproduction if the decoder collapses duplicate branches. Do not choose a branch by endpoint order, minimum id, or arbitrary tie break.

alternatives_preserved.reason_not_selected: It removes the primitive degeneracy but changes the exact physical model and expands the ensemble to 2^36; it is not a remediation of the source-frozen primitive posterior.

alternatives_preserved.alternative: Choose one parallel branch per endpoint pair
alternatives_preserved.reason_not_selected: It silently erases a winding degree of freedom and can change logical loss.

alternatives_preserved.alternative: Use only the endpoint incidence matrix
alternatives_preserved.reason_not_selected: Parallel branches have identical charge boundary, so incidence alone cannot recover homology or physical provenance.
The blocker is topology, not posterior cost or sampling noise. Approximation cannot validate a lossy representation.

compute_budget.stop_rule: Run the branch-catalog and relation-provenance preflight first. Do not enter quotient or decoder integration after a provenance failure.

next_action: Implement and run the branch-catalog and relation-provenance preflight over both colours and all primitive (E,A) pairs; stop before homology quotient if any relation has zero or multiple branch provenance.
